description: Teach the sidecar ci-gated merge-watch GC to preserve a valid issueId-only seed (fix silent post-merge close failure, CAM-161).

userStories.title: Preserve valid issueId-only merge-watch seed in the sidecar null-state GC
userStories.description: As the cam sidecar in ci-gated ship mode, I need to keep a legitimate issueId-only merge-watch seed (written by `cam ship --finalize` before `gh pr create`) instead of garbage-collecting it, so that the cam-ship enrich step can read the issueId, the completed merge-watch carries a non-null closeIssueId, and post-merge closes the issue on the `none` backend instead of failing silently.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: In makeProductionMergeWatchFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts, the `state === null` branch with an existing file), the GC preserves a valid issueId-only seed (a JSON object whose `issueId` is a string and whose `prNumber` is NOT a number) and deletes only real garbage: malformed JSON, a non-object or array value, or an object with neither an `issueId` string nor a numeric `prNumber`. The discriminator lives on the sidecar side; readMergeWatchState and stashIssueIdInMergeWatch semantics are unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts]

AC2: After one real (non-mock) sidecar merge-watch tick over a filesystem file containing only `{ "issueId": "CAM-XXX" }`, the file still exists and its issueId is byte-intact (no unlink, no rewrite that drops issueId). [oracle: named-command bun test (the real-fs regression added in AC4)]

AC3: In the ci-gated flow, with the seed preserved, the cam-ship.md enrich step (cat merge-watch file || '{}', then jq to add prNumber+mergedBranch) reads the issueId and produces the complete merge-watch state {issueId, prNumber, mergedBranch}; feeding that state through readMergeWatchState + stepMergeWatch on a MERGED PR calls runPostMerge with a non-null closeIssueId equal to the seed issueId. The enrich step in .claude/commands/cam-ship.md and templates/commands/cam-ship.md is NOT modified (its read-modify-write already handles a preserved seed). [oracle: named-command bun test (integration test composing preserved-seed -> enrich jq (skipIf jq absent) -> stepMergeWatch, asserting postMergeFn receives closeIssueId === issueId)]

AC4: A real-fs (non-mock, anti-shadow-mock) regression exists that writes an issueId-only seed to a real temp file, runs the ACTUAL sidecar merge-watch GC/tick code path (not a re-implementation of the discriminator), and asserts file-present + issueId-intact. The test must fail against the current code (which unlinks the seed) and pass with the fix. [oracle: named-command bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts (or test/integration/*), plus reviewer-judgment that the test exercises the production tick, not a mock re-implementing the GC]

AC5: The misleading comments are corrected: in src/release/merge-watch.ts the stashIssueIdInMergeWatch doc claim that stashing 'keeps the sidecar inert' now documents that an issueId-only seed is preserved (not collected); in src/commands/sidecar.ts the null-state garbage-collection comment now documents the preserve-valid-seed vs delete-real-garbage distinction. [oracle: file-assert grep -qi 'preserv' src/commands/sidecar.ts && grep -qi 'preserv' src/release/merge-watch.ts, and grep -vq the stale 'keeps the sidecar inert' wording in merge-watch.ts stash doc]

AC6: The immediate merge mode is untouched: makeProductionMergeWatchFn / runMergeWatchFn is wired only in ci-gated mode, and no immediate-mode behavior changes. [oracle: named-command bun test test/release/merge-watch.test.ts (cases j/k: runMergeWatchFn absent in immediate, present in ci-gated, still pass)]

AC7: Full quality spine green: check:all passes (typecheck, tests, file-size and coverage ratchets). embed-vendor is NOT required because no vendor/ or templates/ file is touched. [oracle: bun run check:all]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes:
ROOT CAUSE (grill Option B, single-file, no separate stash file, no TTL): src/commands/sidecar.ts:makeProductionMergeWatchFn, the `state === null` branch (around :373-378 on current HEAD; ANCHOR BY FUNCTION+BEHAVIOR, not line number, it drifts). Today it does existsSync -> unlinkSync unconditionally. readMergeWatchState (src/release/merge-watch.ts, around :69-94) returns null for an issueId-only seed because it requires a numeric prNumber (:76). So a legitimate pre-PR seed written by `cam ship --finalize` is treated as garbage and deleted at the next 2s idle tick, before the cam-ship enrich step reads it. Fix: read the raw file in the null-state branch and discriminate valid seed (object + issueId string + no numeric prNumber) => preserve; real garbage => delete. 

SCOPE GUARDRAILS (from issue spec): (1) DO NOT add a separate .cam-issue-stash.json file (rejected at grill as a workaround that leaves the wrong unlink standing). (2) DO NOT change readMergeWatchState semantics (prNumber-absent == not-pending is correct) nor stashIssueIdInMergeWatch (already correct read-modify-write, preserves+updates issueId; :158-173). (3) Orphan seed (ship aborts before gh pr create) is ACCEPTED by operator decision, harmless, next `cam ship --finalize` overwrites it: DO NOT add TTL/staleness. (4) writeMergeWatchState preserves issueId (:107-120), so once enrich writes full state, later pollCount ticks keep the issueId. 

ANTI-SHADOW-MOCK (AC4 is the crux): CAM-121 tests masked this bug by using a no-op stashFn and never running the real sidecar tick against an issueId-only seed. The regression MUST exercise the real GC code path. makeProductionMergeWatchFn is currently NOT exported (sidecar.ts:360). To make the real tick testable without shadow-mocking, either export makeProductionMergeWatchFn and run one tick (the issueId-only-seed path early-returns before ghPollFn, so no real gh needed), OR extract the null-state GC into an exported real-fs helper that the tick calls and test that helper against a real temp file. Do NOT re-implement the discriminator inside the test.

AC3 is a behavioral consequence, not a template edit: the enrich snippet lives in .claude/commands/cam-ship.md:106-113 (WATCH=$(cat ... || '{}') then jq '. + {prNumber, mergedBranch}'); with the seed preserved it already yields the full state. Verify it end-to-end (real jq via Bun.spawn, skipIf jq absent) but DO NOT edit cam-ship.md or its templates/ mirror (no embed-vendor needed).

COLOCATION (CAM-149 robustness): the fix lives on the sidecar reader/GC side, so it survives a future rewrite of who WRITES the seed.

PATTERNS TO LOAD (scripts/cam/patterns.md): 'JSON reader shape guards: validate discriminator fields, not just typeof' (US-R2-001), 'Real-git integration test pattern' / real-fs equivalent (mkdtempSync + rmSync in finally), 'spawnSync exit-status guard' (guard `(result.status ?? 1) !== 0` if you touch any spawn), 'Bun.spawn stdin/stdout pattern for shell-script integration tests' (for the jq step, skipIf Bun.which('jq') === null). MEMORY note 'merge-watch consume-on-read is by-design': the terminal consume-on-read (removeMergeWatchState) is DISTINCT from this null-state GC defect; do not touch the terminal path.

DOC REF: docs/recovery-runbook.md section (t) 'CAM-101: ci-gated merge mode' documents the merge-watch lifecycle; re-check it before coding and keep its diagnosis steps consistent if you change GC behavior. Test file: test/release/merge-watch.test.ts (existing merge-watch suite; the AC4 anti-shadow test may live here or under test/integration/).
